description: This file defines the EmployeeSalaryController class within the OrangeHRM project. It manages the salary-related views for an employee, setting up data components for frontend rendering, such as currency, pay grade, and account types, and handling permissions. It extends BaseViewEmployeeController and uses traits for service management and internationalization.

classes.name: EmployeeSalaryController
classes.description: Controller responsible for managing the employee salary view, preparing data for frontend display, and setting permissions based on employee number.

methods.name: getPayGradeService
methods.description: Returns the PayGradeService instance for retrieving pay grade related data.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the frontend component with salary-related data such as currencies, pay grades, account types, and pay frequencies; also sets permissions for the employee based on the request.

methods.name: getDataGroupsForCapabilityCheck
methods.description: Returns data groups required for capability permission checks.
